task: mine_ideabase 29 Sep: OPEN/DEFERRED/UNTESTED ideas buildable on exp85a + CLOSED ideas whose closing reason is void after the new public reads; max 10; no public fitting
written: 2026-09-28 ~20:05 UTC (local files only, no Kaggle calls)
summary: The idea base is close to exhausted for 29 Sep. ideas.json has 509 ideas: 245 refuted, 128 in-plan, 61 lb-tested, 47 deferred, 26 lab-tested and 2 open-untested (I-106 SEC with the pilkwang primary, superseded by n2a; I-233 is poller ops). Neither open-untested idea can be built. ONE candidate has a closing reason that is now void: I-029, a constant +0.1 voxel z shift before integer rounding, on NON-CI files only. Its main anchor, 'coordinate-only lab gains read 0 on the LB (float probes 32/33)', fails for two reasons. (1) Discussion 744093 and round 28's recheck show those float probes were no-ops by construction, because the scorer casts to integers. (2) Coordinate levers did transfer publicly: coordhead +0.002 (probe 31), CI +0.001 (probe 48), and 744093's floor -0.008 on public vs our lab's floor_zyx -0.005. Its lab is exp60 x138, 56 train clips, both embryos: edge J +0.0017 (44b6 +0.0024, 6bba +0.0015). The value comes from train, not from the public board. It needs a ~20-line writer patch plus a byte gate (topology identical, only z +1 on ~5-15% of rows). It fits one UNUSED non-CI morning slot (by 11:30Z, ~30 min dummy), and it needs the user's yes because it is outside the {K, SEC, DIS 2.25, CI} whitelist. After an existing CI step the z shift was refuted (R25-RC-B), so CI files do not get it. Two weak env-knob options exist: FLOW_Z_WEIGHT 0.6 (EV ~0, unknown sign) and READMIT_RADIUS_UM 5. The second is not recommended: it steps along probe 50's public-read direction (more low-score readmits), which the user condition excludes. Seven revival checks keep their closing reasons: DIVERGE 2.5, start-leaf prune, N1 extrapolation, CI ALPHA 1.0, ILP APPEARANCE/EDGE weights (math-redundant with DIS/DIV), the retention guard and ILP-fork restore. The new reads (K +0.002, CI +0.001, cap 6 optimum, cap 8 -0.001) strengthen the closures of every fork-volume and fork-removal idea. Honest default: UNUSED stays right unless the user approves the z-shift file.

Ledger rule: map exp91* -> safetail (non-CI). NON-CI only; never on CI files (R25-RC-B).

Caveat: 0.1 was grid-picked in-sample from {0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.25} (0.1-0.25 all similar), and the head that creates the bias was trained on the same embryos.
